meta.attribution: Server records originate from the official MCP Registry maintained by the Model Context Protocol project.
meta.disclaimer: Compatibility verdicts are derived from published registry data and documented client behaviour. No connector was executed or audited.

connector.name: GitLab MCP Server by jmrplens
connector.registryDescription: Go MCP server for GitLab: 2 dynamic tools reach 1000+ REST/GraphQL actions. Free/CE, no paid tier.
connector.summary: Hosted at gitlab-mcp-server.fly.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the desktop bundle gitlab-mcp-server-linux-amd64. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jmrplens account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: PRIVATE-TOKEN
headers.description: GitLab Personal Access Token (glpat-...). Alternatively, send Authorization: Bearer <token>.

headers.name: GITLAB-URL
headers.description: Target GitLab instance URL (e.g. https://gitlab.com). Required in the public hosted multi-tenant instance.

headers.name: PRIVATE-TOKEN

headers.name: GITLAB-URL
headers.description: Target GitLab instance URL. Omit if the server was started with --gitlab-url.

env.name: GITLAB_URL
env.description: GitLab instance URL (default: https://gitlab.com; set for self-managed instances)

env.name: GITLAB_TOKEN
env.description: GitLab Personal Access Token (glpat-...)

env.name: GITLAB_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY
env.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for self-signed certs (default: false)

env.name: TOOL_SURFACE
env.description: Tool catalog selector: dynamic, meta, or individual (default: dynamic)

env.name: CAPABILITY_SURFACE
env.description: Resource and prompt catalog selector: full or minimal (default: full)

env.name: META_PARAM_SCHEMA
env.description: Meta-tool input schema detail: opaque, compact, or full (default: opaque)

env.name: GITLAB_TIER
env.description: GitLab edition tier: free/ce, premium, or ultimate. When unset, detected from GET /license (fallback free). Gates Premium/Ultimate tools; GitLab.com Ultimate also exposes Orbit Knowledge Graph tools. Replaces the deprecated GITLAB_ENTERPRISE boolean

env.name: GITLAB_READ_ONLY
env.description: Read-only mode: disables all mutating tools (default: false)

env.name: GITLAB_SAFE_MODE
env.description: Safe mode: intercepts mutating tools and returns a JSON preview instead of executing (default: false)

env.name: EMBEDDED_RESOURCES
env.description: Append EmbeddedResource content blocks (clickable links to MCP resources) to get_* tool results (default: true)

env.name: EXCLUDE_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated tool names to exclude from registration (e.g. gitlab_admin,gitlab_runner)

env.name: GITLAB_IGNORE_SCOPES
env.description: Skip Personal Access Token scope detection and register all tools regardless of token permissions (default: false)

env.name: UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_SIZE
env.description: Maximum attachment upload size in bytes or human-readable (e.g. 2GB). Default: 2147483648 (2 GB)

env.name: GITLAB_MCP_ALLOWED_IMPORT_DIRS
env.description: Extra OS path-list-separated directories allowed for local GitLab import archives

env.name: RATE_LIMIT_RPS
env.description: Per-server tools/call rate limit in requests per second; 0 disables it (default: 0)

env.name: RATE_LIMIT_BURST
env.description: Token-bucket burst size when RATE_LIMIT_RPS is greater than 0 (default: 40)

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Logging verbosity (default: info)

env.name: AUTO_UPDATE
env.description: Auto-update mode: true (auto-apply), check (log-only), false (disabled). Default: true

env.name: AUTO_UPDATE_REPO
env.description: GitHub repository slug for release assets (default: jmrplens/gitlab-mcp-server)

env.name: AUTO_UPDATE_INTERVAL
env.description: Periodic update check interval in HTTP mode (default: 1h)

env.name: AUTO_UPDATE_TIMEOUT
env.description: Startup/background update timeout, range 5s-10m (default: 60s)

recipes.code:
Download the bundle, then open it with Claude Desktop:

https://github.com/jmrplens/gitlab-mcp-server/releases/download/v2.6.0/gitlab-mcp-server-linux-amd64

recipes.cli: claude mcp add --transport http gitlab https://gitlab-mcp-server.fly.dev/ --header "PRIVATE-TOKEN: <your-private-token>" --header "GITLAB-URL: <gitlab-url>"
gemini mcp add --transport http gitlab https://gitlab-mcp-server.fly.dev/
